title: Conformal Adversarial Generative Ensemble
abstract: arXiv:2609.38196v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Accurate time series forecasting is critical across various domains, yet traditional ensemble methods often suffer from the disproportionate influence of extreme forecasts. We introduce the Conformal Adversarial Generative Ensemble (CAGE), a novel framework that combines generative modeling, adversarial discrimination, and conformal prediction to enhance forecast reliability and accuracy. CAGE employs multiple generative models to produce initial forecasts, which are then evaluated by a discriminative component using conformal prediction techniques. P-values derived from nonconformity scores help dynamically adjust model weights, minimizing the impact of unreliable forecasts. This approach ensures that only the most credible predictions contribute to the final ensemble output. translated_abstract: 准确的时序预测在各个领域都至关重要，然而传统集成方法常常受到极端预测不成比例影响的困扰。我们提出了保形对抗生成集成（CAGE），这是一个新颖的框架，结合了生成建模、对抗判别和保形预测，以提高预测的可靠性和准确性。CAGE采用多个生成模型产生初始预测，随后由一个使用保形预测技术的判别组件进行评估。从非一致性分数导出的P值有助于动态调整模型权重，最大限度地减少不可靠预测的影响。这种方法确保只有最可信的预测才对最终集成输出做出贡献。我们对来自新西兰牛奶收集的时序数据以及来自公开owid-monkeypox数据集的全球健康数据进行了实证和统计分析
tldr: 提出了CAGE框架，结合生成建模、对抗判别与保形预测，利用非一致性分数的P值动态调整模型权重，有效抑制极端预测的影响，提升时序预测的可靠性与准确性
en_tdlr: CAGE is a novel framework that combines generative modeling, adversarial discrimination, and conformal prediction, dynamically adjusting model weights via p-values from nonconformity scores to mitigate extreme forecasts and improve time series forecasting reliability and accuracy
